name: A Sanctuary For You
source:
You are a lighthouse keeper, and you must keep the light shining through the night. To that end you must look after the light, the building itself, and yourself.  The safety of all who pass through this area relies on you, after all...

It's a dependable routine for you. Wake up, decide what needs done today, sleep. You can do it almost without thinking. You don't need to think anymore, even-

If things break from your routine, who knows just what memories you'll stir up?

[From [url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/a-sanctuary-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是灯塔守护者，你必须让灯塔照亮黑夜。为此，你必须照顾好灯光、建筑物本身和你自己。毕竟，所有经过这个区域的人的安全都取决于你……

这对你来说是一个可靠的例行公事。醒来，决定今天需要做什么，睡觉。你几乎不用思考就可以做到。你不需要再思考了，甚至——

如果事情打破了你的常规，谁知道你会唤起什么样的回忆？

[来自[url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/a-sanctuary-for-you]itch.io[/url]]
